task: Fix the infinite redirect loop in i18n language switching for the default language.

project_context.custom_routing: urls.py has a 'root_language_handler' function for the root ('/') path. It checks 'translation.get_language_from_request(request)' and redirects foreign browsers (e.g., 'en') to '/en/'.
project_context.template_tags: A custom tag 'change_lang' in 'lang_helper.py' calculates the translated Wagtail page URL.

the_bug.description: Users with an English browser visit the site and are successfully redirected to '/en/'. However, when they click the 'TR' language switcher link to return to Turkish, they are trapped in a loop.
the_bug.root_cause: The 'TR' link simply points to the root URL ('/'). Since 'prefix_default_language=False', there is no language prefix in the URL. Django's LocaleMiddleware falls back to the browser's Accept-Language header ('en'). The 'root_language_handler' sees 'en' again and immediately redirects the user back to '/en/'. The user cannot switch to Turkish.

required_solution.strategy: Implement Django's built-in cookie-based language setting mechanism ('set_language' view). Instead of simple <a> tag links, the language switcher must use a POST request to save the selected language code into the session/cookie before redirecting.
instructions_for_claude: 1. Locate the frontend template file containing the language switcher links (e.g., base.html, header.html).
2. Replace the simple <a href="/tr/"> links with a hidden form pointing to "{% url 'set_language' %}" with POST method.

3. Use a JavaScript function attached to the <a> tags' onclick events. This function must dynamically fill the hidden form's 'language' input with the target language code, and the 'next' input with the URL provided by the '{% change_lang target_lang %}' template tag.
4. Submit the form via JavaScript so Django sets the 'django_language' cookie and redirects the user.
5. Ensure CSRF tokens are included in the hidden form.

code_blueprint.html_form: <form id='language-form' action='{% url "set_language" %}' method='post' style='display: none;'>{% csrf_token %}<input type='hidden' name='next' id='lang-next' value=''><input type='hidden' name='language' id='lang-code' value=''></form>

output_requirement: Provide the exact code snippets needed to update the frontend HTML files to implement this POST-based language switcher. Explain briefly how the cookie bypasses the LocaleMiddleware browser check.
